answer: An agent economy serving a quartz mine and its jetty weights each agent’s voting power by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days, rather than counting identities. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand accounts still buys only 100 tokens of influence, so a whisper campaign of fake agents gains no extra votes. To gain more control, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, tying up capital for the full lock period.
